description: Every computably enumerable relation of fixed finite arity has primitive-recursive finite certificates for membership.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.finite_arity_certificate {n : ℕ} {R : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop}
  (hR : REPred R) : ∃ C, (PrimrecPred fun p => C p.1 p.2) ∧ ∀ (x : Fin n → ℕ), R x ↔ ∃ t, C x t
